summary: Authored a 5-phase, 6-hour plan implementing the research report's Direction (a): factor orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh's readiness predicate into a shared set, add a roadmap_batches walk as Mode A's primary candidate source (readiness-filter, zero-probe skip on empty, probe the first non-empty batch through the unmodified suggest_from_candidates/orchestrate-batch-admit.sh chain), then fall back to the three mechanical options only with an explicit stated reason. Phases 3 and 4 (test suite, docs) run in parallel; the final phase redeploys and runs the complete verify-deploy.sh gate set plus a live acceptance attestation. Re-validated all four carried description figures (1085 lines, zero roadmap refs, source_dir, binding constraint) and found two new mechanical couplings the research missed: usage()'s fixed sed -n '2,94p' header range and index-entries.json's line_count drift.
